Autumn rules for the gate team
This section explains the steps that matter

Companion Animal Travel Desk Control Procedures

This section sets the required desk practice for safe, clear handling of companion animal travel at Aurelia Skyways. Staff must give passengers plain guidance before departure and confirm that the carrier, documents, and animal condition are suitable for the journey. Any sign of distress, unsafe containment, or missing paperwork must be raised at once, and the traveler must be told what must change before acceptance can continue.

The desk must treat each case as urgent and consistent. Staff will review hazards with the safety coordinator when there is any doubt about heat, space, ventilation, or behavior, and prevention steps must be explained without delay. If a traveler such as Chloe Nguyen, Chloe Muller, or a pet such as Ziggy is presented, the desk must rely on the same standards and must not allow familiarity to reduce caution. Every discussion with the passenger must be calm, direct, and free of mixed messages. If a carrier is damaged, crowded, or unsuitable, the animal must not proceed until the issue is corrected to the satisfaction of the desk lead.

Records must be entered promptly and kept clear enough for handover. Staff must note the condition of the animal, the checks completed, and any advice given to the traveler. If a concern affects the safety of the aircraft, the cabin team, or the animal, the matter must move immediately to the senior coordinator for decision. No exception may be made on convenience alone.

For unresolved cases, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at once.
